Cc: TideWorks AP <ap@tideworks.com>
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: New pay channel onboarding - bank stub + remit layout attached

Hi Ava,

Thanks for the quick intake call earlier. Attached are the bank account stub and our preferred remittance layout for TideWorks so you can validate routing and PO mapping on your side. Files attached: bank_stub.pdf (bank statement stub) and remit_layout.xlsx (column mapping + sample).

Key items we need confirmed:
- That the bank routing/account numbers match the format you require for ACH and wire.
- The exact PO label string we should include on invoices so remits reconcile automatically.
- Any additional KYC fields your finance team needs (tax id, business address, certificate).

We plan to accept ACH primarily but can enable wire rails if needed. If you can confirm a micro-deposit window (typical 2 small deposits), we will trigger verification once your team confirms the mapping.

Attachment stubs:
- bank_stub.pdf (pdf)
- remit_layout.xlsx (xlsx)

Best,
Jared Morales

vendor-ops@finportpay.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

Thanks Jared — got the attachments and the remit sample. A few quick asks from our side so Procurement + Finance can move forward:

1) Can you send your W-9 (or equivalent tax form) and the legal business address to include in the vendor record?
2) Confirm whether FinPort prefers: ACH only, Wire only, or both. If ACH, do you accept CTA / CCD formats?
3) What is the exact PO label you want on invoices? We need the literal string that appears in the remit layout so we can map during intake.

Marissa (cc) — I’m handing this to FinOps for banking validation. Marissa, can you confirm the micro-deposit window we should expect and whether we need an approvals exception to enable wires for this vendor?

If it helps, we can add Ben Carter from Payments to the final confirmation for ledger onboarding.

Thanks,
Ava Chen

Hi Jared —

Thanks for the W9 and the confirm on rails. Finance has verified the routing and account numbers from the bank_stub.pdf against our bank lookup and everything looks good. We will proceed with ACH micro-deposits to the account you provided. Expect two small deposits in 1–3 business days. Once you confirm receipt we will mark the vendor active for ACH.

Mapping notes for Redwood intake:
- PO reference string to map: "PO#|TIDEWKS|INV" (we will match exact and also allow minor whitespace variants).
- Remit file format accepted: CSV with columns [invoice_number, po_ref, amount, remit_date]. Example attached (remit-example.csv).
- Wires: default disabled; if TideWorks requests a wire we need a signed SOW or procurement approval (please route requests to ap@tideworks.com with subject "WIRE: FinPort - Approval").

Attachment stubs:
- remit-example.csv (csv)

Ben — copying you for ledger ingestion. No further action unless micro-deposits fail.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Finance Ops | Redwood Inference
